# AWS project guidance

Follow the project's existing instructions first. For AWS work in this project:

- The project uses the new AWS experience. Say "project", "team member", and "selected Region" where those terms apply.
- Use `ap-southeast-2` for regional AWS resources. Do not create regional resources in another Region or use cross-Region actions.
- Keep S3 buckets private and AWS credentials out of source control and frontend code. Use secure backend configuration for secrets.
- Before AWS implementation or troubleshooting, search the AWS Agent Toolkit documentation for a relevant skill and load that skill when available.

Source: [AWS Agent Toolkit new-experience guidance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/refs/heads/main/rules/aws-starter-rules.md)
